checked_clearances.observation: The generator assigns trade-day 23:59 KST rather than observing it. History is restricted to dates before the trade day and available_at strictly before 09:00 KST. Rebasing uses the latest visible historical close per ticker. Prefix causality is conditional on synthetic availability and frozen-value assumptions; actual historical availability is not verified.

The draft matches the 2022-12-29 cutoff, final 20 prefix sessions, complete valid rows, raw traded-value ranking, same-cutoff leverage/inverse metadata and ordered ten-ticker cohort. The supplied receipt reports zero post-cutoff raw objects. There is no development-period reselection; historical classification vintages remain unverified.

The builder chains FLUC_RT and anchors at the last close. The stated estimand matches next adjusted_open/current adjusted_open - 1 with adjusted_open = open*adj_close/close. This is a derived retrospective valuation level and is not exact cash-distribution reinvestment total return or an actionable historical open fill. Positive per-ticker rescaling cancels from ratios and history rebasing if underlying past returns are unchanged; it does not prove absence of corrections.

Long-only weights with sum <= 1, zero return on residual cash, absolute pretrade weight-change turnover including sells, and multiplicative 10/30-bps costs match the engine. The first observation is zero and CAGR uses elapsed calendar days. The terminal session provides the final valuation open, with no final signal or liquidation cost. Both-session missing/nontradable checks cover proposed tickers union prior positions, including current-open full sales and explicit zero-weight tickers. Missing holdings are never silently dropped or assigned synthetic settlement.
